title: US Dollar: Fed support seen fading – Commerzbank
summary: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke notes that while the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) unanimous rate hike and hawkish tone have supported the Dollar, markets already discount further tightening of about 75 basis points by mid-2027.
